primary_target: Article Model 6: country-day binomial-logit infection-course PM2.5 association with temperature, sunshine, weekday, and country effect.

decisions.decision: Use the article-selected Model 6 as the only primary variant.
decisions.basis: Article Tables 1–2 report the lowest RMSE for Model 6; Model 7 humidity is not the selected model.

decisions.decision: Retain all four UK nations but reduce the analytic outcome period to the verified common public-data window.
decisions.basis: The historical archive provides four-nation overlap through 2020-06-30; after 10-day lag history and 8-day outcome alignment, 351 complete country-days remain.

decisions.decision: Use Open-Meteo gridded environmental values at the four national-capital coordinates as a source/construct substitution.
decisions.basis: They were decoded and complete for every required environmental date; this does not claim equivalence to article DEFRA country averages.

decisions.decision: Use an 8-day deterministic death shift only as a bounded proxy for the paper's stated 7.92-day mean delay.
decisions.basis: The paper specifies the mean but the exact individual-delay distribution and original outcome series are not present in the recovered public inputs.

decisions.decision: Fit a flexible lag-mean binomial GLM with country and weekday fixed effects.
decisions.basis: It preserves outcome family, pollutant, primary contrast scale, country-day unit, and adjustment domains while explicitly not claiming exact DLNM/mixed-effect reproduction.
